query: I've sketched the states for our booking flow — draft, held, confirmed, cancelled, expired — but I can't tell on paper whether the transitions actually hang together. Can we build something I can click through and poke at before I commit to it?
The retry-and-backoff logic reads fine but I don't trust it. I'd like something throwaway I can run in the terminal and watch behave under a few failure sequences.
Before I wire this scoring algorithm into the real app I want to feel it working on made-up data — a little scratch program is fine, I'll throw it away after.
I have no idea what the settings page should look like. Show me a few genuinely different takes on the same route so I can pick a direction by looking at them.
Can you mock up three or four versions of this dashboard screen? Not polished — I just need to see the options side by side in the browser.
We keep arguing about the onboarding layout in the abstract. Build a couple of throwaway variants on /onboarding so we can stop arguing and just look at them.
This spec discussion is going in circles because nobody can picture the thing. Give me something cheap and concrete we can react to instead of more prose.
I'm mapping out the work for this feature and one of the open questions can only really be settled by seeing a rough working version first.
Is a queue-per-tenant model actually going to feel right? I'd rather stub it out and run it than keep reasoning about it in my head.
Give me a design direction for this product — colour palette, typography, spacing scale — no code, just the system.
Here's a screenshot of our current admin panel. Critique it — does it look professional and trustworthy enough for enterprise buyers?
Build the real password reset flow now: token generation, email, expiry, and tests for each piece.
Write the failing test first, then implement the discount calculation until it passes.
Implement the CSV export endpoint we specced last week and get it merged.
The dropdown on our staging site doesn't open in Firefox. Open it in a browser, reproduce it, and grab the console output and a screenshot.
Take a screenshot of the checkout page as it currently renders so I can confirm the bug is real.
Write the end-to-end test suite covering our signup and login journeys.
Refactor this view module into smaller components without changing what it renders.
What's the current exchange rate between EUR and PLN?
